record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, increase embedding and matching hidden-channel width from 64 to 96 while retaining tied input/output item embeddings. Greater representation capacity may distinguish item interests without the regression previously observed from untying embeddings. Preserve feature definitions, six-block causal topology, dilations, history policy, pooling, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer. Save the width in metadata and reconstruct the identical single model in prediction.

category_rationales.rationale: Increase tied item embedding and matching hidden-channel width from 64 to 96 across all four datasets to test greater representation capacity. Preserve causal topology, features, scoring, loss and optimizer. Existing metadata saves HIDDEN_UNITS, and the predictor writer reconstructs the model using that saved width, maintaining checkpoint consistency.
